statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); case "$cwd" in "$HOME"|"$HOME"/*) dir="~${cwd#"$HOME"}";; *) dir="$cwd";; esac; branch=""; [ -n "$cwd" ] && branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null || git --no-optional-locks -C "$cwd" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); printf '\033[01;32m%s@%s\033[00m:\033[01;34m%s\033[00m' "$(whoami)" "$(hostname -s)" "$dir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf ' \033[33m(%s)\033[00m' "$branch"; [ -n "$model" ] && printf ' \033[36m[%s]\033[00m' "$model"; [ -n "$used" ] && printf ' ctx:%.0f%%' "$used"; true
